title: Bound finite-chain evolution without charging onsite detuning as propagation speed
statement: With B=hbar=1 in the one-particle Jacobi model and calibration box, for initial support through site R, cut at L and d=L-R, ||(Uinfty(T)-UL(T))P_R||<=T*sum_{n>=d}(1.21T)^n/n!. If d+1>1.21T, this is at most T*(1.21T)^d/d!/[1-1.21T/(d+1)]. An initial spatial tail eta adds2eta.

requires: Specified positive-energy harmonic signal/soft leads, hard-core memory charge and complete two-output stationary scattering. Use the correct relative phase frame. Quantitative calibration box is the one in the acquired proof. Boolean reuse additionally supplies ideal charge-compatible flag encoding/control, with original memory fixed during scattering.
provides: With B=hbar=1 in the one-particle Jacobi model and calibration box, for initial support through site R, cut at L and d=L-R, ||(Uinfty(T)-UL(T))P_R||<=T*sum_{n>=d}(1.21T)^n/n!. If d+1>1.21T, this is at most T*(1.21T)^d/d!/[1-1.21T/(d+1)]. An initial spatial tail eta adds2eta.
assumptions: No homogeneous spin-impurity capacity-two solution, bound molecule beyond capacity, multiphoton gate or reversible loader. Positive local Schur margin is not a continuum gap. Finite chains have echoes and no identical infinite-time S matrix. Boolean proof/code/dynamics originals are unacquired: tight direct bound, arbitrary degree-four compiler, pulse/gap/error claims remain source reports. An all-N flag extension needs explicit charge grammar and compatible memory zero states. Native phase/preparation/hardware/independent-noise/full-cycle advantage remain open.
costs: Direct emitter detuning costs201B per missing excitation and span201mB. AND trees pay m-1 flags, bounded individual but growing total interactions, computation/storage/uncompute and source preparation. Full output error includes the soft port. Finite-time bound is one-particle and pays chain length plus initial spatial tail; large onsite energies are not free controls.
contract.units: B=hbar=1; T is measured in inverse binding-energy units, d counts lattice hops, and the error is a state-vector/operator norm. Restore B in every hopping-time factor before using physical time.
contract.obstruction: Acquire physical microscopic ports, calibrated nonlinear interactions, charge-compatible flag preparation and finite-time photon handling. Retain the distinct affine-detuning, extra-register and full-cycle cost interfaces.

body: Move every onsite term, including201(m-K), into the interaction picture. Hopping magnitudes and row sums stay bounded by1.21; fewer than d hops cannot reach the terminal site. Duhamel for the two deleted links times the Dyson tail gives the result uniformly in memory charge. This is finite-time, one-photon evolution; it is not an asymptotic S matrix for a finite chain, a photon preparation theorem or an arbitrary-N dynamical bound.
